jars: The 'for you' text on Day 4 says 'let the body know the day is different' - a 49-year-old IT manager in Pune might find this slightly too 'mindfulness-coach' for his taste, though it's not offensive
Day 5's reference to 'greet your mother and father' feels a bit generic for a man whose primary worry is specifically his mother
The 'go deeper' section on Day 1 uses the phrase 'you are not really there' which might feel a bit like an accusation of not being present for his family
best: Your body is still waking at six in the morning because it does not know the office is gone. It is not weakness to feel this. It is the honest response of a life that has been built around a rhythm that is no longer there.
day1_verdict: This is exactly how I feel every morning - the body remembering a job that's gone, and the app actually named that instead of giving me generic 'stay positive' advice.
